# FrustumSupport fixtures

Reference exports from the Processing version, one folder per case: `model.scad` exactly as
Processing wrote it (Windows line endings, because Java's `println` uses the system line
separator) and `params.json` (the inputs and the PaperPrototyping commit).

Generated by `node scripts/fixtures/frustumsupport/generate.mjs`; edit `cases.json` there to
add cases. `hourglass_top` reproduces Hannah's real export `FrustumSupport/hourglass top.scad`
byte for byte (apart from line endings). Do not edit these files by hand.
